about:
Row 49: build ringgeom_r27.json, the SEARCHED control annulus of every
published window, from the product harvest (ringgeom2.json) plus the rule.

Three routes, each recorded per row in `ring_source`:
  product      the retained product whose own 512-vector reproduces the
               published row's (harvest 2); dish, syn, pb read from it.
  block        corrected-geometry row whose producing product was deleted:
               pb from the export row, syn = pb x (syn/pb) of a surviving
               post-repair product of the SAME block (block_ref_syn.json).
  rule-12m     every other row (frozen-geometry): the pre-repair extractor,
               seti_extract_generic.py.pre-aca-20260923 L65/L85:
               pb = 1.22 lambda_med / 12 m, r = 0.14..0.78 pb, no floor.
The repaired rule (seti_extract_generic.py L133-139): r_in = max(0.14 pb,
f syn), r_out = 0.78 pb.  Keyed (eb, lo, hi) to 1 kHz; a window is a block
and two edges, never a star name.
